“

With its two barrels, one trigger, and vintage feel, this shotgun is perfect for historical reenactments.

— Armory Description

The DBS-2 Double Freedom is a double-barreled Primary Shotgun, compensating its limited capacity with massive stopping power.

Procurement

The DBS-2 Double Freedom can be bought from the Python Commandos page in the Superstore for 400 Super Credits.

Tactical Information

  • Due to the limited capacity, it is not recommended that Helldivers engage large groups of enemies with only the Double Freedom.
  • Helldivers can set the Double Freedom to Volley mode to fire both barrels at once, providing a much larger burst of damage.
    • The Double Freedom's volley mode is great for hitting the weak spots of heavy enemies at close distance, like Charger tails, Hulk vents, Impaler heads or Harvester joints. It doesn't have much use elsewhere, as the Double Freedom's massive damage of 840 is already enough to one-shot nearly any enemy in the game.
    • Using Volley mode on close distance, Double Freedom is also capable to swiftly destroy structures such as Spore Spewer's or Bio-Processors and breaking Grounded Warp Ship shields.
  • Using an armor passive that increases reload speed such as Siege-Ready or Reinforced Epaulettes is highly recommended due to how frequent the reloads are.
